name: Sukur Cultural Landscape
description: Sukur is a hilltop kingdom in the Mandara Mountains of Adamawa State, Nigeria, close to the Cameroon border. The Hidi's (chief's) palace crowns the hill, with villages and terraced fields stepping down the slopes below. Scattered across the landscape are the remains of an old ironworking industry. In 1999 it became the first African cultural landscape on the World Heritage List.
